title: Workspace file safety: cleanup plan, local BPMN pairing, drafts
scenario: 1) planRepoCleanup with tracked paths '../x', '/abs', 'C:/x', '.git/config', a modified file, an unpushed file, an ignored target/ file, an ignored .env, and a baseline whose BPMN is kept. 2) In memory fs, create a.bpmn20.xml with identical baseline, b.bpmn20.xml with edited text vs baseline, c.bpmn20.xml with no baseline, and notes.txt. 3) In memory fs, write a draft, write the same file name again; list a folder with a valid draft, a non-draft file and a draft whose read throws.
expected: 1) Unsafe paths are dropped; modified/unpushed go to keptModified; target/ files are removed; .env stays; a baseline is removed only with its owning BPMN. 2) Result lists a, b, c sorted by id; hasLocalChanges false/true/false (c is a draft with baselineText undefined); notes.txt ignored; a missing directory returns []. 3) Second write rejects with 'already exists' and the first content is intact; list returns only drafts sorted by id, with processName undefined when unreadable.

title: BPMN model parsing, escaping, boundary layout and diagram generation edge cases
scenario: 1) Parse an XML with two processes reusing the same local ids, a commented-out serviceTask, and a BPMNDiagram block carrying bpmnElement refs. 2) Parse a process named 'a &lt; b <c> "q"'; also use single-quoted attributes and activiti: prefix vs default namespace for class. 3) Layout a process with a boundaryEvent attached to a task, and another whose attachedToRef names a missing node, each with a flow in/out. 4) Call generateDiagramSection on XML with no process id, on one with zero flow nodes, and withGeneratedDiagram on a valid one that already has a BPMNDiagram.
expected: 1) Nodes and flows come only from the first process; no phantom duplicates from the second process, comment or DI block; reported offsets still index the original text. 2) name decodes to 'a < b <c> "q"' (no double unescape); single and double quotes both read; prefixed and unprefixed class attributes yield the same value. 3) Attached event bounds touch the host edge and are not passed to ELK; the orphan boundary event still has bounds; flows touching them get straight-line waypoints, no exception. 4) The first two return undefined and the XML is untouched; the third yields exactly one BPMNDiagram with a plane for the process id and a shape per node.

title: Analysis and layout scale to large processes within budget
scenario: 1) Generate a process with 2000 serviceTasks chained by flows and a few gateways; time extractProcessModel and analyseBpmn. 2) Generate 300 chained tasks with 20 exclusive gateways and boundary events; call layoutProcess and generateDiagramSection.
expected: 1) Both finish under a generous budget (for example 3 s); node and flow counts equal the generated numbers; no finding is reported for a valid chain. 2) Promise resolves within a generous budget (for example 15 s); bounds exist for every node, waypoints for every routable flow; the section parses and passes isCompleteFor.
